spans.s:
विट् {c1c} P. (वेटति)
1 To sound.
--2
To curse, rail at.

विटः [विट्-क]
1 A paramour;
त्वद्वत्सलः क्व स तपस्विजनस्य हंता
कन्याविटः पतिरसौ परिरक्षतु त्वां

;
Śi. 4. 48.
--2 A voluptuary, sensualist.
--3 (In dramas) The companion of a
prince or dissolute young man, or of a
courtezan (who is described as
being skilled in the arts of singing,
music, and poetry and as a parasite
on familiar terms with his associate
to whom he nearly serves the
purpose of the Vidūṣaka; see inter
alia Mk. acts 1, 5, and 8); for
definition, see S.

.
--4 A
rogue, cheat.
--5 A catamite.
--6 A
rat.
--7 The Khadira tree.
--8 The
orange tree.
--9 A branch together
with its shoot.
--10 A mineral salt.
--Comp.
--माक्षिकं a kind of
mineral.
--लवणं a medicinal salt.

1 An aviary, dove-cot.
--2 The loftiest point, pinnacle,
elevation; अयमेव महीधरविटंकः

विटपः [विटं विस्तारं वा पाति पिबति
पा˚ क Tv.]
1 A branch, bough (of a
creeper or tree);
कोमलविटपानुकारिणौ बाहू Ś. 1. 21, 32; यदनेन तरुर्त
पातितः क्षपिता तद्विटपाश्रिता लता

.
--2 A
bush.
--3 A new shoot or sprout;
Śi. 7. 53.
--4 A cluster, clump, thicket.
--5 Extension.
--6 The septum of
the scrotum.

विटपिन् m. [विटप-अस्त्यर्थे इनि]
1
A tree; परितो दृष्टाश्च विटपिनः सर्वे
[]

.
--2 The fig-tree.
--Comp.
--मृगः a monkey, an ape.

वीटिः, --वीटिका, --वीटी f.
1 The
betel-plant.
--2 A preparation of
betel (Mar. विडा = तांबूल q. v.).
--3 A
tie, fastening, knot (of a wearing
garment).
--4 The knot of a bodice;

वीटिः, --वीटिका, --वीटी f.
1 The
betel-plant.
--2 A preparation of

--3 A

--4 The knot of a bodice;

विट्ठ(ठ्ठ)लः N. of a form of
Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (worshipped at
Pandharpur in the Bombay
presidency).

वीटा A small piece of wood
(about a span long) struck with
a stick or bat in a game played by
boys (called in Marāṭhī
विटीदांडूचाखेळ).
